findings.summary: Migration registry focused test fails from the required repository-root invocation.
findings.details: The S05-T01 proof relies on migration-registry.test.ts to exercise the generator, but the test computes the generator path from process.cwd(). Under the exact repo-root command, that resolves to `<repo>/scripts/generate-migration-registry.mts` instead of `packages/convex/scripts/generate-migration-registry.mts`, producing ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at line 157 before the generator behavior is proven. Rework should derive the script path cwd-independently from the test module location, then update proof with the exact repo-root command green.
